tweet.text:
AI agent teams burn tokens for almost no quality gain

Vals AI ran GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 on Vibe Code Bench, solo versus teams, at medium and max reasoning. Teams cost 1.8x to 5.1x more. Only one of four comparisons moved the needle: Sol at medium reasoning, up 7.3 points. At max compute, teams helped neither model.

Anthropic's own Opus 5.5 numbers say the same. Knowledge base went 0.53 solo, 0.70 at ten agents, then 0.71 and 0.74 at 30 and 100. Lean proving: 0.39 to 0.66 at ten, then basically flat. Noam Brown's take: four agents twice as fast, twice the cost. Speed, not quality. That's the coordination tax.

More agents buy parallel speed. They don't buy better answers.

#AI #agents #ValsAI
